final: SELECT i.invoice_number, AVG(CASE WHEN ili.derived_total_cost IS NOT NULL AND ili.derived_product_cost IS NOT NULL AND ili.derived_product_cost != 0 THEN CAST(ili.derived_total_cost AS REAL) / CAST(ili.derived_product_cost AS REAL) ELSE NULL END) as avg_ratio, COUNT(CASE WHEN ili.order_item_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) as non_null_order_item_count FROM Invoices i LEFT JOIN Invoice_Line_Items ili ON i.invoice_number = ili.invoice_number GROUP BY i.invoice_number ORDER BY non_null_order_item_count DESC LIMIT 10
